name: experiment-model-inspector
description: Host-GPT experiment explanations from bounded source observations and verified candidate evidence.

interface.longDescription: Host GPT explains mathematical models and metadata-only data flow from bounded code observations, checks inline candidate evidence, and returns native diagrams. No manifest prerequisite, experiment execution or dataset loading.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read my authorized experiment code, explain its model and data flow with evidence and unknowns, and show a native diagram.
